scripts.lint: turbo run build --filter=@jinn/gateway-events && turbo run lint && pnpm lint:root
scripts.test: turbo run test --concurrency=1 && pnpm test:node && { [ "$(uname)" = Darwin ] && pnpm test:node:host || echo "skipping test:node:host — host-dependent suites need macOS (BSD ps, /usr/bin/cc); see test:node:host"; }
scripts.test:node: node --test scripts/__tests__/check-footguns.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/ci-workflow.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/deliverable-evidence.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/publish-workflow.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/ratchet.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/reap-gateways.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/reap-orphan-workers.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/reap-worktrees.test.mjs scripts/__tests__/vitest-flaky-retry.test.mjs
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const d of ['.turbo','node_modules/.cache'])fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true})" && turbo clean
